headline: 3 Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea + ~60 Shahed-type/decoy drones
dek: Russia launched 3 ballistic missiles + ~60 drones overnight Oct 20-21; Ukraine claims 38 downed/jammed, 12 locations hit. Prior day: 165 drones, 115 downed, 30 locations, 16 killed/69 injured incl.
sources: Ukrainian Air Force / Ukrainska Pravda (via political.org tracker); Kyiv Independent; Ukrinform
fault_line: Missiles keep falling while envoys keep flying — does the battlefield decide before the summit does?

sections.what_happened: Russia launched 3 ballistic missiles + ~60 drones overnight Oct 20-21; Ukraine claims 38 downed/jammed, 12 locations hit. Prior day: 165 drones, 115 downed, 30 locations, 16 killed/69 injured incl. children in Kharkiv park strike.
sections.what_verified: Consistent multi-outlet relay of Ukrainian official claims; Sunday Guardian corroborates 4 killed/27 injured in Kyiv region wave; AP corroborates Kharkiv park strike (children among 6).
sections.what_disputed: Russian claims not relayed in this window; casualty/ interception figures are Ukrainian official claims, not independently verified.
sections.why_matters: The war doesn't pause for diplomacy: ballistic missiles from Crimea while Witkoff flies to Moscow.
sections.context: Background: Ukraine — UPDATE: overnight Oct 20-21 Russian attack — 3 Iskander-M/KN-23 ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea + ~60 Shahed-type/decoy drones; Ukraine Air Force: 38 drones downed/jammed; strikes recorded at 12 locations (Ukrainska Pravda); separately Oct 20 wave: 165 attack drones (105 jet-powered Shaheds), 115 downed, 30 locations hit; 16 killed/69 injured nationwide incl. Kharkiv park strike (children among 6 killed)

totw_analysis: Our read: The war doesn't pause for diplomacy: ballistic missiles from Crimea while Witkoff flies to Moscow. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Missiles keep falling while envoys keep flying — does the battlefield decide before the summit does?
